svg.title: Career
svg.desc: Roles over time: BEng Computer & Autonomous Systems, CGPA 9.3/10, UOWD (since sep 2024); Deputy Head of Engineering, UOWD Tech Club (jan-nov 2025); Embedded & IoT Intern: C/C++ firmware, sensor IoT, Emertxe (may-jul 2025); ML Intern: PyTorch, fine-tuned LLMs, Pantech.AI (jul-aug 2025); ECT Board Member, Engineers Australia UAE (since jul 2025); College Ambassador, Techfest, IIT Bombay (jul-dec 2025); President, EA Student Society, UOWD (since jul 2026).
